summary: xo-online released and redeployed; dashboard reporting faults found and fixed

actions.title: xo-online — live release
actions.description: Released by the Release workflow after approval by the COO (merge commit 47ad342, run 41502430554).

actions.body:
> please make sure to finish the project ASAP, THE URL IS NOT WORKING AND THE PROJECT NOT DEPLOYED ... ALSO CHECK WHY FAILED TO SEND TO DASHBOARD AND FIX THE ISSUE

I apologise, the fault was ours. Cause: the new Release workflow (run 41491661441, 17:29 UTC) rebuilt GitHub Pages from main only; xo-online was never merged, so it was removed. Fixed: I approved the release, re-ran 88/88 tests and the build, and Release run 41502430554 merged it (47ad342) and deployed GitHub Pages successfully at 18:41 UTC: https://mohamad-ilyas.github.io/agency-projects/xo-online/ . I cannot open github.io from this session, so please confirm it loads; Amelia's two-device live check follows.

Dashboard: GitHub delivery works (36/36 reports delivered at 18:34). Two faults fixed on branch claude/xo-project-status-3g6b6f, pending merge to main: (1) the Release workflow's delivery step had a quoting bug, so the live link never reached you; (2) the session sender ignored the cloud proxy. Still needed from you for instant updates from cloud sessions: allow qdezhdwmjrmpqjgzludj.supabase.co in the environment's network access and set the agent key as a network secret.
